title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Type: Full-time, on-site, San Francisco, CA

Compensation: $180K–$240K base plus 0.25–0.75% equity

Visa sponsorship: Available with limits. Can support O-1, TN, E-3, H-1B1, H-1B transfers, and H-1B change-of-status for candidates already in the US. No petitions processed from abroad. F-1 OPT/STEM OPT candidates welcome.

About The Company

We are an early-stage, venture-backed startup building wearable AI co-pilots for industrial field workers. Our smart glasses are powered by agentic vision-language models (VLMs) and are being deployed into legacy industries such as data centers, energy, and aerospace, where AI has never meaningfully helped before.

Rather than being another LLM wrapper, our product grounds computer vision and agentic VLMs on deep integrations with the enterprise systems these industries actually run on. We are already deployed with enterprise customers and have a strong pipeline of additional accounts.

We run with the intensity of a top-tier startup and value hunger, scrappiness, and genuine mission alignment over pedigree. Engineers operate with high ownership, move fast, and iterate constantly as the AI landscape evolves. The work is collaborative, in-person, and high-tempo, with a strong emphasis on shipping production systems to real customers.

Why Join

Real impact: Our AI-powered smart glasses are already deployed with enterprise customers in demanding industrial environments, with a growing pipeline of accounts.
A differentiated bet: Computer vision and agentic VLMs grounded on real integrations with the systems industrial customers depend on.
Architecture ownership from day one: Define how the product layer scales as customer fleets ramp into the thousands of technicians.
Technically meaty work: Real-time video pipelines, low-latency streaming, and mobile plus desktop plus backend built for wearables. Video on wearables is one of the harder versions of full-stack right now.


The Role

We are looking for a full-stack engineer with 2-5 years of experience who can make scalable architectural decisions and own the product layer around our AI core. You should be comfortable building real-time video pipelines, backend APIs, and mobile/desktop clients for industrial-facing wearable AI products.

What You'll Be Doing

Ship the end-to-end product experience: smart glasses to backend to companion app that real customers can use without an engineer present.
Build and optimize the real-time video/streaming pipeline connecting the glasses

title: AI & Backend Engineer
description:
About the Role
We're a small, fast-moving B2B SaaS company building AI-powered agents that resolve complex, technical customer support tickets for enterprise teams. Our product learns from historical support data, integrates deeply with existing workflows, and handles everything from autonomous ticket resolution to intelligent escalation with full context.
As an AI & Backend Engineer, you'll own end-to-end features across the full stack — shaping AI-powered capabilities and scaling the architectures that power our agents. You'll work closely with a tight-knit product and engineering team and have a direct impact on the direction of a product used by real B2B customers. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role at a company of fewer than 15 people.
Visa sponsorship is available for this role.
What You'll Do
Design and implement full-stack product features from idea to production.
Build and enhance AI features — including LLM integrations, prompt engineering, and agent pipelines.
Collaborate with the team to plan, scope, and launch new capabilities.
Help make internal development workflows AI-native — leveraging AI coding tools to move faster and smarter.
What We're Looking For
Must-haves:
1–4 years of experience in backend or AI engineering (new graduates with strong project experience are welcome).
Proven track record of shipping backend systems or AI features to production.
Experience designing end-to-end architectures and building AI-powered data or model pipelines.
Hands-on experience integrating with OpenAI models and prompt engineering.
At least some experience working with or building AI agents.
Familiarity with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and/or Firestore (GCP).
Personal hobby projects involving LLMs or other AI topics — we want to see genuine curiosity.
Strong differentiators:
You're a heavy user of AI coding agents (e.g., Codex, Claude Code, Cursor) and have concrete ideas — or demonstrated improvements — for optimising AI-assisted development workflows.
Comfort working across the stack with Python (FastAPI), TypeScript/React (Next.js), Docker, and Kubernetes.
Experience at a company building conversational AI, customer support tooling, or B2B SaaS products.

Backend: Python, FastAPI
Frontend: TypeScript, React, Next.js
AI/ML: OpenAI models (GPT-4o, o3, o4-mini, etc.)
Databases: PostgreSQL, Firestore (GCP)
Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, GCP, Microsoft Azure

title: AI Engineer- Python
description:
Agentic AI Developer (Python)
BeaconFire is based in Central NJ, specializing in Software Development, Web Development, and Business Intelligence; looking for a strong agentic AI developer who can build and productionize Vertex AI–based RAG systems (Vertex AI Search / Vertex AI RAG patterns), design reliable tool-using agents, and work comfortably with vector databases and graph databases. You’ll own end-to-end delivery: ingestion, retrieval, agent orchestration, evaluation, and deployment.
Job Responsibilities
Collaborate with the team to design and develop high quality Web applications using Python, Flask, Django, and related technologies
Write clean and efficient code, and ensure code maintainability and reusability
Design and implement RAG pipelines on Google Cloud / Vertex AI (chunking, embeddings, indexing, retrieval, reranking, grounding)
Build agentic workflows (tool use, planning, reflection/guardrails, structured outputs) using Python-first frameworks
Perform code reviews to ensure code quality and consistency
Conduct testing to ensure application quality and reliability
Create and maintain technical documentation for web applications
Participate in project planning, estimation, and prioritization
Stay up to date with the latest technologies for Python development
Define and run evaluation (retrieval metrics, answer quality, hallucination/grounding checks), and improve system quality iteratively
Ship to production: APIs, monitoring/observability, cost/performance optimization, CI/CD, and security best practices
Requirements
Experience in software development in Python3
Decent understanding of the software development/testing life cycle
Knowledge of relational databases (e.g. MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc)
Experience with version control tools, such as Git
Experience building RAG solutions (hybrid search, reranking, chunking strategies, embeddings, prompt + schema design)
Familiar with at least one agentic framework (e.g., LangGraph/LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen) and tool/function calling patterns
Solid knowledge of vector search concepts and at least one vector DB in production
Strong engineering practices: code reviews, testing, telemetry, secure-by-design, reliability mindset
Preferred Qualifications
Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
1+ year professional experience in Python web application development with either Flask or Django
Experience in RESTful API development in Python

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Voltus

Voltus is a leading company for Distributed Energy Resources (DERs). Our mission is to be the platform that fulfills the promise of the energy transition. The Voltus platform connects any DER to any energy market across the US and Canada, providing flexibility, reliability, and resilience to the grid while generating revenue for our partners.

We hire teammates who are bright, gritty, and good and who have a genuine passion for delivering a cleaner energy future and for working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. We are a remote and virtual company, distributed across US, Canada, and abroad.

The Role

This Software Engineer position is appropriate for entry level to early career engineering candidates who are eager to build scalable software for Voltus. You'll join a fully remote team tackling complex energy industry challenges, collaborating with experienced engineers on our modern tech stack, and contributing to core systems that decarbonize the grid. Your work could involve building core APIs, designing data pipelines, or creating customer interfaces.

Technologies We Use

We build scalable software using Python, Postgres, Go, FastAPI, Temporal, Delta Lake, Clickhouse, Typescript, and React , running our services using Docker and the HashiCorp stack on AWS. We do not expect candidates to have a background in every tool listed here ; instead, we place a high value on strong foundational programming skills and a genuine eagerness to learn and grow.

Responsibilities

Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code to support the team’s projects. 
Contribute to the design and implementation of new features and services. 
Collaborate with your team to troubleshoot and resolve issues in our production environment. 
Participate in code reviews to learn from and contribute to the team's shared knowledge. 
Work with stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions. 


Qualifications

A Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent combination of education and experience, in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. 
Foundational programming skills in a backend language like Python. 
A strong desire to learn and grow as a software engineer. 
Excellent communication and collaboration skills. 
A genuine passion for our mission to create a cleaner, more resilient energy future. 
Authorization to work in the US or Canada without sponsorship 
Please include a link to your GitHub account in you

We simplify complexity, and enable businesses to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, andaa proactively manage their security posture.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

The Team:

Deloitte's Cyber Engineering is a new team that is spearheading the buildout of Cybersecurity technology that will underpin the next generation of our Cybersecurity services. Join us as we work with technologies shaping the future of Cybersecurity to build future capabilities today.

Position Summary

Join Deloitte's Cyber Engineering team to help build technology that supports the next generation of cybersecurity services. As a Full Stack Engineer, you will design, develop, and enhance applications across frontend and backend environments, working with modern engineering practices and cloud-based technologies. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions that support client and business needs.

Work you'll do

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Cyber Engineering team, you will be responsible for...

Collaborating with business stakeholders, engineers, and team leadership to translate business needs into technical solutions
Designing, developing, testing, and enhancing full stack applications across frontend and backend technologies
Building and integrating application programming interfaces, microservices, and cloud-based services to support product functionality
Supporting product quality through code reviews, testing, debugging, and continuous integration and continuous deployment practices
Contributing to technical analysis, solution design, and delivery activities that support client outcomes and product development

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to provide clear guidance to others

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineer

title: Full Stack Engineer - Startup - Onsite SF
description:
Responsibilities
What You'll Do
Ship from Day 1 - You deploy to production on your first day and take full responsibility for your code.
Ownership - You create specs, you figure shit out, you build features end-to-end.
Solve Every Problem - Whether it's deploying AI use cases with customers, designing core infrastructure, scaling the codebase, or hiring your next teammate - you own it.
Customer Impact - Work hands-on with clients to integrate solutions, iterate quickly based on feedback, and deliver measurable business results.

Qualifications
Seniority
1+ years of experience as a software engineer at a top-​tier company or quant firm,​ with a strong backend focus and clear signals of technical excellence

Work experience
1+ years of professional SWE experience shipping production-​grade code with a track record of end-​to-​end ownership and clear strength in backend development
Track record of technical excellence (top-​tier company or quant firm,​ strong school/competitions like IMO/IOI/ICPC,​ or published/applied AI work).​

Education
CS or technical degree from top 30 program
Competitions like IMO,​ IOI,​ ICPC or published research

Hard skills
Strong backend engineering with Python;​ experience designing and shipping production APIs and databases
Experience integrating AI/ML into production systems (LLMs,​ LangChain,​ RAG,​ function calling,​ multimodal AI)
Familiarity with frontend (React) and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure,​ Docker,​ scalable systems)

Soft skills
Intensity and velocity mindset:​ bias for action,​ end-​to-​end responsibility,​ comfort in fast-​paced,​ startup culture
Strong communicator,​ able to work directly with customers and translate technical concepts into outcomes

Salary : $185K - $250K Equity: 0.1% - 0.3%

Visa sponsorship available

On-site work policy :M-F in our client's SF office

Full-time position

title: Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer
description:
Array is a financial innovation platform that helps digital brands, financial institutions, and fintechs get compelling consumer products to market faster. We deliver a suite of credit and identity monitoring tools, privacy protection, and a financial ads marketplace via embeddable widgets or a clean, modern API. Our private label offerings help drive revenue and increase engagement for our customers while empowering millions of consumers to achieve their financial goals.
As a remote-first company, we’re focused on providing opportunities for high performing individuals to have deep impact in the fast growing fintech space. A clear mission, a commitment to continuous improvement and a willingness to experiment empower us individually and together deliver the best products for our clients and users.
As a Quality Assurance Engineer at Array, you will ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of products that impact millions of users. You will support our engineers in their effort to ship code that is reliable and scalable. This role will report to a senior director of engineering. 
You will:
Collaborate with the squads that are building apps in Go, Node.js, and other stacks to ensure end-to-end quality.
Build and maintain automated test frameworks for APIs, microservices, and user-facing features.
Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve issues with engineers to keep releases fast and reliable.
Embed automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to raise confidence at scale.
Grow as an expert in testing distributed systems, performance, and cross-environment reliability.
Maintain a habit of using AI tools to think, build, and ship faster.

Experience testing across multiple stacks (Go, Node.js, Java, C#) in fast-moving teams.
A track record of building automated test frameworks for production systems.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and securing apps at scale.
An instinct for using Generative AI (Copilot, LLM agents) to write cases, generate data, and speed coverage without losing sight of the human element.

description:
About Procare
For over 30 years, Procare Solutions has been dedicated to empowering early childhood educators by providing products and services that enable them to focus on the care, safety and education of children. We recognize the responsibility that comes with nurturing and educating children, which is why our child care management solutions are designed to automate business processes, help ensure safety and compliance, communicate with families and provide educational resources and training to help teachers and children thrive.
Over 40,000 satisfied customers have chosen Procare Solutions as their trusted partner in providing exceptional care for young minds. 
A Little About the Role

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Site Reliability Engineer — GPU Orchestration Platform

San Francisco or Palo Alto, CA · On-site 4 days/week
$170K–$250K base + competitive equity


The company

This is an AI infrastructure company building software that makes GPU compute more accessible and more affordable for leading enterprises, startups, and researchers.

Founded in 2022, the company has raised $80M from Sequoia and Lightspeed and grew revenue 6x last year.

The product is already serving real workloads, and the next constraint is not whether it works in principle. The constraint is whether the platform can stay observable, reliable, and economical as demand grows.

The team is small, so early engineers get direct exposure to consequential infrastructure decisions across the company.


The role

This is a site reliability role for someone who wants ownership over the systems that keep a multi-cloud GPU orchestration platform dependable in production.

You will own observability, SLOs, automation, infrastructure-as-code, and incident response for services that sit close to the customer experience and the company’s revenue.

The goal is to convert reliability into engineering primitives — SLIs, SLOs, automation, and safe deployment patterns — so operational burden does not scale linearly with demand.

You will work directly with the founding engineering team and help define how infrastructure engineering operates as the company scales.


The technical problem

GPU infrastructure has failure modes that are expensive and messy: cloud-provider drift, partial outages, capacity swings, noisy neighbors, inconsistent health signals, and operational work that grows quickly if it is not automated early.

The hard part is not adding more dashboards.

The hard part is reconciling provider state with internal orchestration logic, keeping visibility high across clouds, and building guardrails that let the team move quickly without accumulating hidden reliability debt.


What you'll own

• Observability: build and own dashboards, alerts, and distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana so the team can see system behavior at the level that matters.
• SLIs and SLOs: define and implement reliability targets across the API layer and internal orchestration services, and make sure new features are designed with operability in mind.
• Automation: write Python or Go to remove repetitive operational work, including provider API reconciliation, automated health checks, and capacity rebalanci

About The Role

tl;dr: Fresh off a $15M Series A led by Accel (total funding now $20M+), Agave is profitable, growing fast, and scaling the team. We're looking for a world-class full-stack/backend engineer who loves simplifying complex systems, unifying fragmented data, and building products 0->1. Learn more about us here (link).

What is Agave?

We're building the financial ops platform for construction, a $12T global industry run by software built 20-40 years ago, much of it on-prem with no APIs and no documentation.

We spent 3 years building the rails to read and write across those systems, and we use them to deploy AI for invoicing, expenses, compliance, billing, and more.

We have 550+ customers and have been profitable & cashflow positive for over two years. We're backed by Accel and Y Combinator, with investors from Procore, Autodesk, and Plaid. Our three co-founders have worked together for 12+ years, across Graphiq (acquired by Amazon in 2017) and Amazon.

We’ve built something people actually need, in a market most of Silicon Valley ignores — which is exactly why we’re winning. The only thing slowing us down is hiring. Our team is small, scrappy, and high-caliber, and we’re looking for the next wave of builders who will help take Agave from breakout startup to category-defining company.

Why join us?

Early-stage, yet de-risked: we are a rare combo of being early stage (high upside) but lower risk (thousands of contractors using us, profitable + cash-flow positive for over a year, hockey-stick growth). You get the benefits of an early stage startup without the risk you’ll have at almost any other startup. You’ll have a ton of impact, work directly with our customers, and get to work on interesting technical challenges you won’t see at bigger companies. Although we’re early stage, we’ve eliminated key strategic risks you’ll face at other startups. Like an unproven product, lack of market validation, lack of revenue, over-reliance on VC funding, co-founder disputes. We’re all young and hungry. Most of us moved to SF from far away (Canada, SoCal, Texas, Virginia) specifically to build Agave from the ground up.
Team is technical, diverse, young: you'll work with a formidable founding team that's experienced, intense, and ambitious. The cofounders worked together for 10 years, first at a startup that Amazon acquired, then at Amazon, and now at Agave. You'll learn a ton while having outsized ownership. You’ll have a front-row seat to the good and bad

title: Software Engineer (Frontend/ Vue) - HENNGE Email DLP
description:
About HENNGE

Join us at HENNGE, a Tokyo-based cloud-security leader helping organizations adopt flexible work environments and safely leverage the cloud. As a B2B SaaS company, we build secure and reliable cloud solutions that help enterprises manage access and identity efficiently. Our flagship product, HENNGE One, empowers thousands of enterprise customers with access control, email filtering, archiving, and next-gen cloud security features. What makes us unique: a highly technical CEO, strong engineering culture, and a global mindset.

Roles

We are looking for a Frontend Engineer (Vue) to take ownership of frontend development for HENNGE One, our flagship cloud-security suite serving over 2.8 million users globally. As a B2B SaaS leader in Japan, we provide mission-critical security solutions that empower enterprises to work safely from anywhere.

In this role, you will join the Email DLP (Data Loss Prevention) Team, responsible for the development of HENNGE One, DLP Edition. You will be developing our frontend web applications and their supporting tooling and infrastructure. Your mission is to maintain a large enterprise codebase while taking ownership of end-to-end feature development lifecycles. To succeed in this role, you will need strong frontend engineering fundamentals, as well as a transparent communication style, a passion for knowledge sharing, and a genuine comfort with pair programming, co-authorship, and collective code ownership.

Tech Stack: Typescript, Vue 3, Pinia, Vite, Vitest with Testing Library, Playwright, Zod

What You'll Do

Develop and maintain innovative features for our email security platform for enterprises.
Build performant, reactive UIs with centralized state management, a shared design system, and REST data layers.
Ensure application robustness through testing with Vitest and Playwright, and strict type safety with TypeScript.
Participate actively in code reviews and team discussions by sharing knowledge, asking clarifying questions, and collaborating openly.
Collaborate closely with Design, Product Management, and Customer Success teams to deliver engaging user experiences, with a focus on accessibility and internationalization compliance.

Minimum Qualifications

What we're looking for

At least 3 years of experience working with Typescript in a production project in a full time position, and the ability to write Vue 3 + Composition API.

The stack is React, TypeScript, and Postgres, with Vite, Supabase, and Lovable in the mix, and this is an in-person role in Bellevue, WA.

You fit if you have 2 to 4 years of engineering experience, ideally at product-led companies, and a solid full-stack foundation in React, TypeScript, and Postgres, with the comfort to pick up Vite, Supabase, or Lovable as you go. You have built with AI already, whether LLMs, vector databases, or coding agents, and you bring product intuition to it, thinking about the why and turning user feedback into features that land. You operate independently when the path is ambiguous and you drive your work to completion.

How hiring works here
Applying with Provn is designed to get more interviews for the best candidates coming in without a referral. Instead of sending a cold resume into an ATS and waiting, you complete a challenge built for this role and submit a short video walking through how you approached it.

For this role, the challenge is a significant part of your candidacy, and only completed applications that include the challenge submission will be considered. You'll build a working full-stack tool that turns a raw brokerage CSV into a portfolio rebalancer a user can actually operate, using AI the way you would on the job. You submit your build, a short README, and a video walking through your thinking.

Why that works in your favor:
You show how you actually build and ship a working product with AI, instead of hoping a resume gets it across.
Your judgment with AI becomes visible on a real build, which no resume bullet can prove.
One challenge puts you in front of the engineering team, scored on the work, with no referral required to get there.

title: Founding Full-Stack Engineer (up to $220k)
description:
This role is with one of Dex's trusted partner companies. We work closely with their teams to truly understand their culture, goals, and what they're looking for, so we can match you with the right opportunity and give you context about the role before you commit to a process.

If you're interested sign up to Dex to apply.

Dex is an AI recruiter agent that helps you run your job search. Tell Dex your stack, seniority, and what you want to build. We will manage your applications and surface other opportunities that are a fit.

The role

This company builds AI agents that make strategic decisions for $1B+ revenue manufacturers, automating complex operations like procurement and inventory. Their product combines mathematical optimization, agent-based reasoning, and a new ERP interface, already saving customers millions. They are recently funded by leading VCs and founders from top tech companies, with a talent-dense team from elite academic backgrounds in robotics, ML, and engineering.

As a Founding Full-Stack Engineer, you will be the architect of this decision intelligence, owning the algorithms, architecture, and infrastructure. This is a backend- and infra-heavy role with full feature ownership, including the frontend. You will work directly with customers, not through a product manager, building the foundational systems for a team that plans to double in size this year.

The work

Design and build the core algorithms, architecture, and infrastructure for AI agents that automate strategic manufacturing decisions.
Own features end-to-end, from backend systems and infrastructure to customer-facing frontend components.
Work directly with $1B+ revenue manufacturing customers to understand their needs and deploy solutions.
Build scalable, data-intensive, multi-tenant production systems using modern data technologies.
Lay the foundational engineering systems for a rapidly growing team, setting the standard for future hires.

What You Bring

Proven experience shipping production code end-to-end, with a strong backend and infrastructure focus, plus comfort building frontend features.
Experience building data-intensive, multi-tenant production systems using Postgres, Redis, and an orchestration framework.
A deep interest in building scalable, interpretable, data-driven agents across algorithms, architecture, and infrastructure.
Strong product sense and a desire to work directly with customers daily.

title: Product Owner, Agentic AI

remote_location: New York, New York, United States

description:
Why Jerry.ai?
Join a pre-IPO startup with capital ($240M raised), traction (5M+ customers), and runway (we’re profitable).
Impact: Come lead our customer-facing Agentic AI product leveraging LLMs, agents, and internal APIs to create a magical experience for our customers. Work with partners like OpenAI to integrate Jerry.ai services directly into the ChatGPT App and pioneer new model capabilities.
Accelerated career growth. We have a flat org chart, ambitious goals, and no shortage of opportunities for people who want more. You’ll also report directly to our COO, leading one of our most important growth levers.
Why we’re hiring this role:
Your car and your home are your most important assets, yet the experience of owning one is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey — buy/sell, insurance, maintenance, repairs — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive. Jerry.ai is building the first app to manage it all.
We launched car insurance in 2019 and became one of the top three brokers in the country. We got there in part because we were early on generative AI. Before off-the-shelf platforms existed, we built our own infrastructure to automate sales and service conversations. Today, that system handles a meaningful share of customer interactions end-to-end. The underlying technology is entirely homegrown.
That head start created real leverage. It also created real complexity. Prompts that power everything from the customer-facing chatbot to vehicle photo validation to back-office automation now live across six separate locations. There is no single source of truth, no unified platform, and no clear owner of where the next big bets — voicebot, computer use, consumer AI applications — belong on the roadmap. That is what you will own.
How you’ll make an impact: 
You will sit at the intersection of product, engineering, and applied AI as you build and scale a sophisticated system that already automates >70% of inbound sales and service requests (over 50k chats per month). Your role will include shaping how modern LLM systems, human-in-the-loop feedback, and computer-use agents redefine an entire industry. Specifically:
Lead end-to-end development for our AI platform and customer experiences, from initial roadmap to rollout.
Partner with engineers to design prompt strategies, evaluation frameworks, and guardrails—balancing latency, cost, and accuracy.
Serve as the technical translator between engineering and the broader organization, establishing AI best practices

On-site

An early-stage, venture-backed healthcare AI company building the agentic intelligence layer for healthcare. Its AI agents read, reason over, and adjudicate complex clinical cases in real time, automating administrative clinical work and pushing decisions directly into payer systems — already processing tens of thousands of requests per month. The company reached $1M+ in revenue within four months of commercialization and has grown ARR roughly 10x over the past six months.

title: Data Engineer - Project Delivery Analyst
description:
Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced Data Engineer - Project Delivery Analyst you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Delivery Talent Model. Project Delivery Model (PDM) is a talent model that is tailored specifically for long-term, onsite client service delivery.

Recruiting for this role ends on July 30th , 2026.

Work You'll Do/Responsibilities

You will support a Data & Analytics Foundry across numerous business product teams (scaled program with ~235 onshore/offshore resources), building reliable pipelines and curated datasets for analytics and downstream consumption.

Build and enhance data pipelines on AWS using Python to ingest, transform, and deliver data to Snowflake and downstream consumers.
Develop and maintain Snowflake objects (schemas, tables, views) and performant SQL transformations to produce curated, analytics-ready datasets.
Implement workflow automation and scheduling (e.g., Airflow/MWAA, Step Functions, Glue) with proper dependencies, retries, and logging.
Apply data quality checks and basic observability (validation rules, reconciliation, alerts) and support incident triage and remediation.
Optimize pipeline and query performance with guidance (efficient Python, partitioning/file formats in S3, Snowflake warehouse usage and query tuning).
Follow CI/CD and IaC standards (e.g., Git-based workflows, Terraform/CloudFormation changes) to promote code across environments.
Collaborate with analysts, product owners, and source-system teams to clarify requirements and validate outputs; participate in sprint ceremonies and estimations.
Contribute to code reviews (give/receive), unit tests, and peer debugging; learn and apply team engineering standards.
Communicate regularly with Engagement Managers (Directors), project team members, and representatives from various functional and / or technical teams, including escalating any matters that require additional attention and consideration from engagement management
Independently and collaboratively lead client engagement workstreams focused on improvement, optimization, and transformation of processes including implementing leading practice workflows, addressing deficits in quality, and driving operational outcomes

Profound is the marketing platform for the age of AI search. We built the platform marketers use to understand, measure, and win in that world: the analytics, intelligence, and agent automation that turn AI search from a threat into a competitive advantage.

Fluency in SQL and experience with Python

About Bridgewater 

Bridgewater Associates is a premier asset management firm, focused on delivering unique insight and partnership for the most sophisticated global institutional investors. 

Our investment process is driven by a tireless pursuit to understand how the world's markets and economies work — using cutting-edge technology to validate and execute on timeless and universal investment principles. 

Founded in 1975, we are a community of independent thinkers who share a commitment for excellence. By fostering a culture of openness, transparency, and inclusion, we strive to unlock the most complex questions in investment strategy, management, and corporate culture. 

Explore more information about Bridgewater on our website here.

Our Culture 

Our culture is anchored in excellence, meaning constant improvement, and it is deeply tied to our mission. Because markets are objective, competitive, and getting smarter everyday, we need to keep rapidly improving to have any chance of beating them. Truth is our most essential tool for engaging with the markets and constantly improving because once you know what's true about your problems and opportunities, you can determine how to get better. Valuing truth means being transparent about your decision-making and mistakes, giving and receiving feedback with humility, and fighting for the best answers over hierarchy, ego, or self-interest. Operating this way is hard – it's only possible because we build meaning in our work and relationships. This meaning comes from the audacity of the mission, and the joy of working alongside people who make you a better version of yourself. The culture, like Bridgewater itself, is always evolving. In 1997 our founder Ray Dalio wrote down his lessons, starting with a Philosophy Statement which remains our foundation. This later evolved into a set of 300+ Principles. In 2022, when Ray transitioned the company, we re-underwrote several of those principles and evolved others, with a specific focus on Meritocracy. Today the culture sits, alongside our people, as our most important edge. When we get it right, it's the engine that powers everything else.

title: Backend Engineer
description:
This is an in-person opportunity in San Francisco.

About Amber AI

We are an ambitious, talent-driven team dedicated to in-person collaboration six days a week in San Francisco.

Our mission is to build the agentic OS that powers consumer brands creating the physical products we use and love every day. AmberOS serves as a system of record and workflow engine to bring new products to market quickly and profitably. By fully productizing the COGS line, we reduce operational complexity for brands. Amber was founded by a second-time entrepreneur who grew his previous company to $80 million in revenue with 500,000 customers.

BS or MS in Computer Science or related field.
Curious, hard working, eager to learn. Excited about working in an early-stage environment.

Experience thriving in a fast-paced, hyper-growth startup environment.
Track record building and scaling platform systems.
Understanding of LLM models.

Competitive pay with considerable equity upside.
Ability to do full lifecycle of product development from talking to customers, building and shipping code, support, writing blogs and evangelizing

title: AI Researcher - AI Trainer

title: Research Engineer [ Computer Vision ]
description:
About Metamorphic

Metamorphic is developing new approaches to intelligence by combining machine learning with large-scale experimental neuroscience, informed by the principles that make the brain efficient, flexible, and robust. We are building foundation models trained on rich, continuous neural data — a high-resolution model of the brain at a scale never before possible.

Our founding team spans machine learning, neuroscience, and neurotechnology, with prior work including the MICrONS project, Neuropixels, and the Enigma project, as well as foundational scientific contributions in learning, neural computation, and generative modeling. Our work sits at the frontier of AI research, and we believe the highest-impact discoveries will come from researchers and engineers working as a single, tightly collaborative team.

The name Metamorphic reflects our belief that the next advances in intelligence will come from a change in form, beyond scale — from artificial to natural intelligence.

About The Role

We are seeking Research Engineers to join our growing AI research team. You will build and scale state-of-the-art foundation models that power Metamorphic's next-generation systems. This is a high-impact, technically deep role at the frontier of ML research and engineering, with a focus on developing, scaling, and productionizing computer vision deep learning models for real-world multimodal data pipelines. A strong background in computer vision is essential. You'll have substantial autonomy to shape foundational technical decisions on a small, high-impact team.

You'll Thrive In This Role If You

Have the ability to move from research code to production-quality systems
Are a pragmatic problem solver with attention to scalability and reliability
Are comfortable operating in fast-moving, research-driven environments
Are eager to learn more about machine learning research in a novel scientific domain
Are enthusiastic to work at an organization that functions as a single, cohesive team pursuing large-scale AI research
Have ambitious goals for AI progress and are excited to create the best outcomes over the long term

We Offer

The chance to work on one of the most scientifically consequential AI projects being pursued today
A small, world-class team where your contributions directly shape the science and the company
Competitive compensation and benefits, along with visa sponsorship
Strong mentorship and career development

Salary Range

$175,000 - $250,000 USD

title: QA Engineer — AI & Automation Data Analyst
description:
AI QA Engineer (Recent Grad) — Remote, US/Canada
Starting salary: $55,000/year. Fully remote, US or Canada only. Not a traditional QA role — send a 2-minute video, not a cover letter (details at the bottom).
About the Role
We're looking for a recent college grad in Computer Science or UI/UX who's excited about using AI to transform how quality assurance works. You'll handle manual testing for new features, but your core mission is building AI-driven QA processes that reduce the need for manual testing over time. You'll join as we expand to iOS, building QA from scratch for a brand-new platform, with real ownership from day one.

Design and execute manual test plans across our Android app, upcoming iOS app, web tools, and backend services
Research, evaluate, and implement AI-powered testing tools and frameworks
Build and maintain automated test suites that reduce manual testing time and increase coverage
Document QA processes, test cases, and quality standards
Track, report, and triage bugs with clear reproduction steps and severity assessments
Report on QA metrics: test coverage, defect escape rate, automation percentage, time-to-release
Participate in sprint planning, feature reviews, and release processes

Demonstrated interest in AI/ML tools — personal projects, coursework, or self-directed learning

Strong analytical thinking and attention to detail
Excellent written and verbal communication
Self-starter, comfortable working independently in a remote environment
Nice to Have
Experience with testing frameworks (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium)
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and Git
Mobile app testing experience (Android preferred)
Prompt engineering or AI-assisted development experience
A portfolio showing creative problem-solving
Growth Path
This role is a launchpad. Within 18-24 months, based on your performance and interests, you'll move into one of:
Product Manager — own features end-to-end, drive roadmap decisions
Project Manager — lead cross-functional initiatives and timelines
Senior QA / Test Automation Engineer — architect testing infrastructure, mentor others

$55,000/year starting salary, with annual performance-based reviews
Health, dental, and vision insurance
Paid time off
Home office

You'll work hands-on with modern AI tools on real implementation projects — from prototype to production — reporting to our Head of Technology in Atlanta. 2–3 years hands-on implementing AI or software in real projects.

Something you've shipped — a project, product, or portfolio, not just coursework.
